summary: Aurora Cannabis Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnished with a news release dated May 28, 2026, announcing the scheduling of a conference call to discuss its fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026 financial results. The call is set for June 11, 2026, with the results released before market open. The registrant is the issuer. There are no terms, deal structure, or special-situation components. This is a routine earnings announcement and investor communication, not a special situation. No action or event triggers a classification under any special-situations category.
